results.name: Crunches
steps: Lay flat on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the ground, about a foot from your lower back.
Place your fingertips on your temples with your palms facing out.
Draw your belly into the base of your spine to engage the muscles, then raise your head and shoulders off the floor. Return to starting position and repeat.

results.name: Laying Leg Raises
steps: Lay on your back with your arms palms down on either side.
Keep your legs together and as straight as possible.
Slowly raise your legs to a 90° angle, pause at this position, or as high as you can reach your legs, and then slowly lower your legs back down.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

results.name: Long Lever Plank
steps: Start in a hand plank position and walk your hands further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

results.name: Hanging Knee Raises
steps: Grab the bar and hang, your body still and your legs straight.
Slowly draw your knees up to your chest

Once you have raised your knees as high as possible, lower your legs and repeat. Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.
Duration of these movements should be slow so that you do not utilize momentum, enabling you to get the most out of the exercise.

results.name: Forearm Plank
steps: Place forearms on the ground with your elbows bent at a 90° angle aligned beneath your shoulders, with your arms parallel at shoulder-width.
Your feet should be together, with only your toes touching the floor.
Lift your belly off the floor and form a straight line from your heels to the crown of your head and hold.

results.name: Bodyweight Hand Plank Jack
steps: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump hands outward simultaneously while keeping feet planted and core tight.
Jump hands back under shoulders, maintaining stable hips and spine.

results.name: Bodyweight Feet Plank Jack
steps: Start in high plank, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet out wide while bracing core and keeping hips level.
Jump feet back together, maintaining plank alignment throughout.

results.name: Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist
steps: Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, and clasp hands at chest.
Rotate torso to one side without lifting feet.
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.

results.name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Crunch
steps: Start by lying flat on your back on a ball with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent.
Engage your core muscles and flex your spine until you feel your abs contract.

results.name: Stability Ball Stir The Pot
steps: Kneel behind a stability ball, place forearms on top, and engage your core muscles.
Lift knees, balance on toes, and slowly move forearms in small controlled circles.
Maintain a stable torso, avoid excessive movement, and reverse direction after several rotations.

results.name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
steps: Start in a plank position with your feet on a stability ball and hands on the floor.
Engage your core and tuck your knees toward your chest, rolling the ball forward carefully.
Extend your legs back to the starting position, maintaining balance and control throughout the movement.

results.name: Stability Ball Pike
steps: Place your feet on the ball and get in to a plank position.
Pull your hips straight up toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips until you're back in a plank position.

results.name: Stability Ball Atomic Push Up
steps: Place feet on a stability ball, hands on the floor in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, then push up while tucking knees toward your chest.
Extend legs back to starting position, maintaining control and stability throughout the movement.

results.name: Stability Ball Windshield Wiper
steps: Lie on your back, legs extended, stability ball between your feet, arms out for support.
Engage your core, lift your legs, and rotate them side to side in a controlled motion.
Keep your upper body stable, move slowly, and return to center before switching directions.

results.name: Stability Ball V Up Pass
steps: Lie on your back, holding a stability ball between your feet, arms extended overhead.
Engage your core, lift your legs and arms, passing the ball from feet to hands.
Lower arms and legs back down, then repeat, passing the ball back to feet.

results.name: Hanging L Sit
steps: Hang from a bar with arms fully extended.
Lift legs to form an "L" shape.
Hold for allotted amount of time keeping your abs flexed.

results.name: Bodyweight Plank Arm Lift
steps: Start in a plank position.
Raise your arm out in front of you.
Return to the starting position, then raise the opposing arm.
Make sure to keep your hips stable. If you're unable to, try performing this exercise from the knees.

results.name: Bodyweight Plank Jack
steps: Start in a plank position, hands under shoulders, body straight.
Jump feet wide, then back together, like a jumping jack.
Keep core tight, maintain plank form, repeat for desired time or reps.

results.name: Bodyweight Hanging Knee Tuck
steps: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Lower legs back down, maintain controlled movement.

results.name: Bodyweight Hanging L Sit
steps: Grip bar, hang with arms extended, body straight.
Engage core, lift knees towards chest.
Hold that position for the specified amount of time.

results.name: Reverse Crunch Kick Up
steps: Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
Flex at the hips and knees until your hips land back on the bench, then kick your legs back out to the starting position.

results.name: Eccentric Dragonflag
steps: Perform a reverse crunch and then kick your legs up toward the ceiling.
With your hips and knees extended, lower yourself slowly back to the start position.

results.name: Laying Alternating Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, arms by sides, legs straight.
Lift one leg to a 45-degree angle.
Lower leg, lift opposite leg; alternate smoothly.

results.name: Laying Bent Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor.
Raise both knees towards your chest.
Lower back down without touching the floor; repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Alternating Bent Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your back, legs bent and lifted off the ground.
Lower one leg to the ground until your foot taps the ground, keep your other leg up.
Alternate sides for the prescribed amount of reps.

results.name: Scissor Kick
steps: Lie on your back, hands under your buttocks or on the ground for support.
Lift legs off the ground, alternate crossing them in a scissor motion.

results.name: Sideways Scissor Kick
steps: Lift both legs off the ground.
Bring both legs outward, then cross both legs over one another.
Alternating which leg goes on top.

results.name: Reach And Catch
steps: Lay flat on your back with both hands over one leg.
Reach toward your knee flexing your abs and obliques.
Do the prescribed amount of reps, then switch sides.

results.name: Frog Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands behind head.
Crunch up, flexing the spine and your abs.

results.name: Frog Sit Up
steps: Lay on your back with knees bent and your feet together.
Keep your arms extended overhead. Swing your arms to generate some momentum and sit up.

results.name: Elbow Plank Mountain Climber
steps: Begin in an elbow plank position with your core engaged.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow.
Return to plank, then switch legs quickly. Repeat.

results.name: Slow Tempo Mountain Climber
steps: To perform a bodyweight mountain climber, start in a plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Bring your right knee towards your chest, keeping your foot close to your hand. Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee towards your chest.
Continue this movement, alternating legs, at a slow pace for a set amount of time or repetitions.

results.name: Switch Jump Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a plank position with hands under shoulders.
Jump one foot forward, switch legs mid-air.
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady plank.

results.name: Slalom Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a plank position with hands directly under shoulders.
Drive knees toward left elbow.
Go back to starting position, then drive knees to right elbow, mimicking a zigzag slalom motion.

results.name: Jumping Mountain Climber
steps: Begin in a plank position, hands under shoulders, feet together.
Jump feet forward, landing outside hands in a low squat.
Explode back to plank, repeat continuously for desired reps.

results.name: Ring Standing Roll Out
steps: Grasp the rings, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your abs engaged, roll forward onto your toes, and extend your arms in front of you.
Slowly lower your body down toward the ground, keeping your arms straight and your abs engaged.
When your head gets between your arms, pause for a moment and then use your abs to pull your body back up to the starting position.

results.name: Chin Ups
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Close Grip Inverted Curl
steps: Grab the bar with a close grip. Feet on the floor.
Break at the elbow and curl your body toward the bar.

results.name: Bodyweight Inverted Curl
steps: Hang from a bar with your feet on the floor.
Break at the elbows and curl your body towards the bar.

results.name: Bodyweight Concentration Curl
steps: Place your elbow on one knee and your hand underneath the other leg. Keep the leg that's over your hand extended.
Curl the working arm and use your leg as the resistance.

results.name: Bodyweight Assisted Chin Up
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chin above the bar.

results.name: Bodyweight Assisted Pull Up
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chin above the bar.

results.name: Ring Twisting Chin Up
steps: Grab the rings shoulder width apart with a pronated grip (palms facing away).
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up and rotate your fists until your chin is past the rings.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Ring Chin Up
steps: Grab the rings shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the rings.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Gironda Chin Up
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body hanging and arms fully extended, pull yourself up and lean backwards. Try to touch your chest to the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: L Sit Chin Up
steps: Grab the bar shoulder width apart with a supinated grip (palms facing you)
With your body in an "L" position and arms fully extended, pull yourself up until your chin is past the bar.
Slowly return to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Underhand Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with an underhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Assisted Mixed Grip Pullup
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with a mixed grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chin above the bar.

results.name: Bodyweight Assisted Gironda Chin Up
steps: Grasp the chin-up bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Place your feet on the ground, legs bent slightly.
Use your legs to assist as you pull your chest to the bar.

results.name: Ring Curl
steps: Stand holding gymnastic rings with your arms extended in front of you, palms facing up.
Curl rings towards shoulders, squeezing biceps.
Slowly lower rings back to starting position, keeping control. Repeat.

results.name: Ring Row
steps: Set up rings at a high point.
Grip rings and lean back, arms extended.
Pull chest to rings, keeping body straight.

results.name: Walking Calf Raises
steps: Walk forward and push your toe into the ground
Lift you heel off the ground each step and tense your calf muscle
Repeat on each leg and walk forward slowly

results.name: Tip Toe Walking
steps: Point your toes into the floor.
Slowly walk forwards and backward
Keep your heels in the air as long as possible while walking.
It may be beneficial to do this last at the end of your workout.

results.name: Calf Raises
steps: Balance on the balls of your feet on the platform or plates, leaning forward to use the wall to assist with balance.
Lower the heels of your feet towards the ground and pause, then push through the balls of your feet like you are standing tip toe, pausing at the apex of the motion.
Repeat as necessary.

results.name: Bodyweight Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Hold on to something for balance.
Hinge forward and maintain that position. Calf raise until you feel a contraction in your calfs.

results.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Calf Raise
steps: Hold onto something for balance. Raise one foot off the ground.
Raise your heel upwards while keeping your knees stationary.
Pause when your heels are fully extended and then slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

results.name: Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Box Dips
steps: Hold your body with arms locked above the equipment
Lower your body slowly while leaning forward, flare out your elbows
Raise your body above the bars until your arms are locked.

results.name: Incline Push Up
steps: Stand facing bench or sturdy elevated platform.
Place hands on edge of bench or platform, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the bench.
Push body up until arms are extended.

results.name: Decline Push Up
steps: Use a bench to elevate your feet.
Put your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Slowly lower your body until your chest almost touches the ground
Raise your body until you almost lock your elbows.

results.name: Stability Ball Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders. Place your feet on the stability ball.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Leg Raised Push Up
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight, raise one leg off the ground, and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Hands Up Push Ups
steps: Place your hands firmly on the ground, directly under shoulders.
Flatten your back so your entire body is straight and slowly lower your body
Draw shoulder blades back and down, keeping elbows tucked close to your body. Bring chest all the way to the floor and raise hands off the ground.
Exhale as you push back to the starting position.

results.name: Ring Standing Chest Fly
steps: Start by adjusting the rings straps to chest height. Stand facing the rings with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rings' handles with both hands, keeping your arms extended and your shoulders away from your ears.
Lean forward, keeping your arms extended and your core engaged. Your body should form a slight diagonal line from your ankles to your head.
Slowly bring your arms towards each other, in front of your chest, while keeping your core engaged and your body in a stable position.

results.name: Ring Standing Archer Pushup
steps: Position rings shoulder-width apart, grasp handles, extend legs behind.
Lower chest to rings, bend one elbow, while extending your other arm out to the side. Push yourself back to the start.
Then switch arms and repeat.

results.name: Ring Standing Pushup
steps: Start by setting up the rings to a secure anchor point and adjust the straps so that they hang about waist height when you stand under them.
Stand facing the rings grab the handles with both hands, and step forward so that your body is in a plank position with your hands directly beneath your shoulders.
Lower your body down by bending your elbows until your chest nearly touches the handles. Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms as you do so. Make sure to engage your chest, triceps, and core throughout the movement.

results.name: Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Keep legs straight or bent.
Lower slowly until elbows are at
degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

results.name: Bodyweight Box Assisted Dips
steps: Grip the edge of the boxes with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

results.name: Bodyweight Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position on your knees. Break at the elbow and shoulder joint.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Incline Knee Push Up
steps: Start by placing two boxes (or one) on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the box, keeping your arms straight.
Put your knees on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the box.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

results.name: Bodyweight Explosive Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

results.name: Bodyweight Elevated Push Up
steps: Start by placing two plates or low boxes on the floor, about shoulder-width apart.
Position yourself in a plank position with your hands on top of the boxes/plates, keeping your arms straight.
Keep your feet together, with your toes resting on the floor.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the floor by bending your arms, until your chest nearly touches the dumbbells.
Push your body back up to the starting position, straightening your arms and engaging your chest, triceps and shoulders.

results.name: Bodyweight Diamond Knee Push Ups
steps: Begin in a push-up position with your hands forming a diamond shape under your chest.
Lower your body, keeping elbows close.
Push back up to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Clapping Push Up
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lower your chest, explode up, clap hands.
Land softly, repeat for reps.

results.name: Burpee
steps: Start standing with your feet hip-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position, placing your hands on the ground in front of you.
Quickly jump your feet back into a plank position, keeping your body in a straight line from your head to your toes.
Perform a push-up, keeping your core tight and your elbows close to your body.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, and then jump up into the air, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower your body back into the squat position to repeat the movement.

results.name: Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Overhand Inverted Row
steps: Lay underneath a fixed horizontal bar and grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Pull your body straight up to the bar.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Inverted Row
steps: Grab a door frame or a rack and place your feet near the frame.
Start with your elbows extended, row your body towards your hands.
Return to the starting position, your arms fully extended. Repeat.

results.name: Dead Hang
steps: Grip a pull-up bar with palms facing forward.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Hold for recommended amount of time, keeping your core engaged.

results.name: Elevated Pike Press
steps: Use a bench or an object to elevate your feet.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

results.name: Bodyweight Pike Press
steps: Start in a plank position. Push your hips up toward the ceiling.
Lower your head towards the floor by bending your elbows
Push through your hands and return to the starting pike position.
Repeat

results.name: Pole Overhead Squat
steps: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold a pole overhead, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

results.name: Forward Arm Circle
steps: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms forward in small circles.

results.name: Backward Arm Circle
steps: Hold your arms out to your sides.
Rotate your arms backwards in small circles.

results.name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
flex your knees and hips and sit back into the squat while lowering your body
Continue down to full depth
Return to starting position.

results.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position

results.name: Single Legged Romanian Deadlifts
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent and raise one leg.
Without changing the bend in your knee, bend at your hips, and lower your torso until it's almost parallel to the floor.
Tense your glutes and then bring yourself back to the starting position.

results.name: Kickbacks
steps: Get down on all fours and position your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Kick back with one leg and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to starting position by bending your knee and lowering your leg.
Switch Legs. Repeat.

results.name: Forward Lunges
steps: Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until your rear knee nearly touches the ground.
Ensure you remain upright, and your front knee stay above the front foot.
Push off the floor with your front foot until you return to the starting position. Switch legs.

results.name: Good Mornings
steps: Stand with your feet a little past shoulder width apart with a slight bend at your knee. Place your hands behind the back of your head.
Keeping your back straight, rotate your hips to bring your shoulders down towards the floor. Stop when your chest is parallel with the floor.

results.name: Jump Squats
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
When you land, lower your body back into the squat position.

results.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand with your back to a bench (or raised surface) and place one of your feet on the bench.
Squat down until your front leg is about parallel to the floor.
Go back to the starting position. After completing the desired amount of reps, switch legs and repeat.

results.name: Side Lunges
steps: Take a slow, lateral step to the right.
Extend the left knee, and drive your weight into your right side.
Flex your knee and lower your body.
Push back to the starting position.

results.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and then slowly return to the starting position.
Push your hips up, so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Lie down with one knee bent and and one with a slight bend.

results.name: Bodyweight Curtsy Step Down
steps: Stand tall on platform and cross free leg diagonally behind you.
Lower body by bending standing knee, keeping hips square.
Drive through standing heel to return upright with control.

results.name: Half Kneeling Hip Hinge
steps: Place one knee on a bench.
Push your hips back while leaving your knee mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Stability Ball Wall Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, placing a stability ball between your lower back and wall.
Slowly squat down by bending knees to
degrees, keeping back straight and core engaged.
Press through heels, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.

results.name: Bodyweight Stability Ball Hyperextension
steps: Lie face-down on a stability ball, hips centered, feet anchored, hands behind your head.
Engage your core, lift your upper body until aligned with legs, keeping your neck neutral.
Lower your torso slowly back to the starting position, maintaining control and steady breathing.

results.name: Stability Ball Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down on a stability ball, hands on the floor, legs extended straight.
Engage glutes and lower back, raising legs until aligned with your torso.
Slowly lower legs back down without touching the ground, maintaining core engagement. Repeat.

results.name: Stability Ball Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor, place upper back on a stability ball, feet flat, knees bent.
Drive hips upward by squeezing glutes, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower hips slowly without touching the floor, maintaining core engagement, then repeat.

results.name: Stability Ball Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying flat on your back with your feet resting on top of a ball.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the bar.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Stability Ball Straight Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, legs straight, arms by your sides.
Press through your heels, lift hips, engage glutes and core, forming a straight line.
Slowly lower hips, maintaining control, then repeat for reps.

results.name: Stability Ball Single Leg Hip Thrust
steps: Lie on the ball, one foot on the ground.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Curtsy Deficit Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start, keeping bar stable throughout.

results.name: Bodyweight Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
steps: Start by lying on your back with your knees bent and feet in a staggered position on the box.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor, making sure to keep your feet and knees pointing forward.

results.name: Box Jump
steps: Stand in front of a box.
*Start with a low box if this is your first time*
Sink into a quarter of half squat and then pop your hips forward.
Try to land in the middle of the box as softly as possible to minimise impact on your joints.

results.name: Depth Jump
steps: Stand on top of a box. Step off of the box and land on the floor.
Land as softly as possible. Squat as you land to minimise impact on your joints.
Go straight into another hop after you've landed. This will help you learn to absorb impact.

results.name: Seated Box Jump
steps: Setup two boxes. One to jump on and one to sit.
Go from a seated position and pop your hips forward forcefully.
Jump and land on the box softly.

results.name: Single Leg Box Jump
steps: Stand with a shoulder width stance.
Jump onto your box and land with one foot.
Try to land in the middle of the box and land as softly as possible.

results.name: Bodyweight Alternating Jump Lunge
steps: Start in a standing position.
Lunge forward, switch legs mid-air.
Land and repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Figure Four Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot resting on top of a box, and cross one leg over the other.
Push through your heels and raise your hips towards the ceiling, keeping your feet flat on the box.
Engage your glutes at the top of the movement, pause briefly and then lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Put your shoulder blades on a bench. Both feet on a low box or a plate.
Start with your hips up.
Drop your hips and then push your hips up toward the ceiling.

results.name: Bodyweight Lateral Lunge Jump
steps: Start with a shoulder width stance.
Jump laterally and fall into a squat. Tap the ground.
Jump the opposite direction

results.name: Bodyweight Pulse Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in goblet position.
Squat down to parallel depth and then halfway back up.
Stay in this short range of motion for the duration of the set.

results.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Heels Elevated Hip Thrust
steps: Start by lying on a bench with your foot on a plate or low box.
Lift one leg off the ground and engage your glutes to raise your hips up towards the ceiling.
From this starting position, slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Swing Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

results.name: Bodyweight Swingthrough Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position.
Step back with the same leg until the back knee taps the floor.

results.name: In And Out Jump Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Narrow your stance while in the air, and land softly. Go directly into another rep.

results.name: Bodyweight Pop Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start by doing a regular squat, tap the floor, then engage your core and jump up explosively.
Bring your feet mostly together, tap your toes back to the floor, then bring your feet back their original width.

results.name: Bodyweight Alternating Curtsy Lunge
steps: Place the barbell on your back
Step your foot back and around while simultaneously bringing the weight down.
Return to start and repeat on other leg.

results.name: Bodyweight Alternating Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Step right, lunge to side.
Return, then lunge left.

results.name: Bodyweight Alternating Reverse Lunges
steps: Stand with feet together.
Step back with right foot.
Return to starting position, then lunge with left foot.

results.name: Bodyweight Hip Abduction
steps: Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).

results.name: Bodyweight Step Up Knee Drive
steps: Begin by standing in front of a sturdy box or bench that is about knee-height.
Place your right foot on the box and push through the heel to lift your body up and onto the box, bring your off leg all the way through until your leg is parallel with the ground.
Step back down with your right foot, lowering your left foot to the ground.

results.name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Unilateral
steps: Lie on your back. Place one heel on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hip and knee.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heel into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.

results.name: Hamstring Bridge With Elevated Legs Box Bilateral
steps: Lie on your back. Place your heels on a box or bench, having a 90° angle at hips and knees.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the box, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.

results.name: Hamstring Bridge Isometric Open Angle
steps: Lie on your back with knees slightly bent and heels dug in.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Hold the position for the specified duration.

results.name: Glute Bridge Isometric Hold Single Alternate
steps: Lie on your back. Bend your knees so your feet are flat on the floor with heels under knees
Push through your heels into the ground, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees. Squeeze your bum at the top of the movement
Maintain the top position and extend one leg at the time.

results.name: Glute Bridge Eccentric Unilateral
steps: Lie down with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Push your hips up so that your butt is elevated and your back straight.
Tense your glutes and raise your hips towards the ceiling.
Once you are at the highest point you can manage, hold the position for a few seconds, and raise one leg off the ground.
Lower slowly to the start position.

results.name: Bodyweight Alternating Forward Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot and bend both knees to lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push off your right foot to return to the starting position. Then switch legs.

results.name: Walking Lunge
steps: Take a step forward shifting your weight onto the front leg.
Bend the knee of the front leg so the knee of the back leg comes close to the ground.
Stand up and go into lunging with the opposite leg.

results.name: Bodyweight Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box or bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, sitting back onto the box and pausing for a moment before standing back up.
Push through your heels to return to the standing position.

results.name: Bodyweight Kickstand Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, one foot slightly behind.
Lower into a squat, keeping weight on front heel.
Return to standing, engaging glutes and core.

results.name: Bodyweight Ninety Ninety Hip Stretch
steps: Sit with one leg in front of you flat on the ground.
While the other leg is to your side, also flat on the ground with your foot pointed backwards.
Hold this position for the prescribed amount of time then change sides.

results.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Squat
steps: Stand on one leg, extend the other forward for balance.
Lower into a squat, keeping your chest up and core tight.
Press through your heel to stand back up, repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand on a platform, feet hip-width apart.
Step back, lowering knee toward floor, keeping chest upright and core engaged.
Push through front foot, return to start.

results.name: Bodyweight Staggered Waiters Bow
steps: Set up a bar at mid way up your quad. Place the working leg against the bar.
Place one foot behind. You should only be on your toes on that back foot. Your front foot should be planted flat the entire time.
Bend your back knee and push your hips back. Look for a stretch in your front hamstring.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward again until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Bodyweight Waiters Bow
steps: Place a barbell at about midway up your thigh. Press your quads into the barbell.
Push your hips back while leaving your knees mostly extended. Look for a stretch in your hamstrings.
When you feel the stretch, push your hips forward until you're back in a standing position.

results.name: Bodyweight Quad Stomp
steps: Place your foot on a plate or a low box.
Put all of your weight on your front foot and lean forward.
Lower until your calves touch your hamstrings and then extend back up.

results.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Go to your knees and ask someone to hold your ankles.
Put your hands in front of you
With a slight bend in your knees slowly bring your body to the ground (slower is better)
Push up and reset to the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge
steps: Take a big step backwards with your left leg, lowering your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground and your right knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Push through your right heel to return to standing, bringing your left leg back to starting position.
Repeat the movement on the other side, stepping backwards with your right leg and lowering your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground and your left knee is bent at a 90-degree angle.

results.name: Slider Hamstring Curl Single Leg
steps: Lie on your back keeping both knees bent.
Have a slider under the heel of the working leg.
Extend and bend the working lag applying gentle downwards pressure.

results.name: Single Leg Slider Hamstring Curl 2
steps: Beginner
Lie on your back with bent knees and heels on a slider.
Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back on the ground).
Press the heels into the ground to raise your hips off it.
Extend and bend the working leg.

results.name: Slider Hamstring Curl Eccentric
steps: Bend your knees so your feet are flat on the floor with heels under knees and toes raised.
Place sliders under your heels. Perform a posterior pelvic tilt (flatten your lower back against the ground).
Push through your heels into the ground, lifting your hips up to the point where there is a straight line from your chest to your knees.
Extend your legs in a slow, controlled manner, to lower your bum to the ground.
Casually bend knees before repeating.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl
steps: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend and extend the non-weight bearing leg.
Knees should remain aligned.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Hamstring Curl Isometric
steps: Stand up straight using a balancing aid.
Shift your weight on one leg.
Bend the non-weight bearing leg and hold.
Knees should remain aligned.

results.name: Slider Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with slightly bent knees and heels on sliders.
Pull your heels towards your glutes to lift your hips off the ground.
Extend knees to starting position, but do not rest hips on ground.

results.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Balance Stable
steps: Hold on to something stable and pull the leg on the opposing side straight up. Hold this position.

results.name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back, heels on a stability ball, arms flat, and core engaged.
Lift hips, curl the ball toward you using your hamstrings, keeping control and balance.
Extend legs back to start while keeping hips lifted, then repeat for desired reps.

results.name: Pull Ups
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

results.name: Ring Pull Up
steps: Grasp the rings with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the rings.
Lower your body back to starting position.

results.name: L Sit Pull Up
steps: Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, arms and shoulders fully extended. Pull your legs up until you're in an "L" position.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back to starting position.

results.name: Supermans
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms fully extended in front of you.
Simultaneously raise your arms, legs and chest off of the floor and hold the position.
Slowly lower your arms, legs and chest back to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Bodyweight Superman Pull
steps: Lie face down with arms extended straight in front of you.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off floor while squeezing glutes.
Pull elbows toward ribs, squeeze lats, then extend arms again.

results.name: Bodyweight Spinal Jefferson Curl
steps: Stand tall with arms hanging toward floor and knees slightly bent.
Slowly roll down spine, one vertebra at a time, reaching toward toes.
Reverse the motion, stacking spine back up to standing tall.

results.name: Bodyweight Russian Twist
steps: Hover your heels just off the ground.
Stick your chest out and maintain a flat back. Make all the movement happen at your mid and upper spine.
Point your chest to the left, then rotate at the spine until your chest is pointed right.

results.name: Side Plank Up Down
steps: Start with your elbow and hip on the ground. Either neutral fist or flat hand on the ground.
Begin in a side plank position, and then drop your hips to the floor.
Pull your hips back to the ceiling to finish the rep.

results.name: Side Plank Reach Through
steps: Begin in an elbow side plank position.
Reach for the ceiling with your off hand.
Rotate at the mid and upper spine and reach through the open space between the floor and your torso.
Reach backwards, and then rotate back into the starting position.

results.name: Elbow Side Plank
steps: Press your elbow into the floor.
Pick your hips up off the ground and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you don't let your chest fall forward or backward.

results.name: Hand Side Plank
steps: Press your hand into the ground and pick up your hip off the ground.
Open your chest and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.

results.name: Hand Side Plank Reach Through
steps: Start in a side plank position.
Reach your top arm under your body.
Return to the plank position.

results.name: Alternating Heel Touch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Reach right hand to right heel.
Switch sides, left hand to left heel. Repeat.

results.name: Oblique Crunch
steps: Lie on your side, knees bent, hands behind head.
Bring your elbow towards your knees and flex your obliques.

results.name: Oblique Jackknife
steps: Lie on your side, legs straight, hand behind head.
Lift both legs and upper body simultaneously.
Squeeze obliques, then lower back down. Repeat on both sides.

results.name: Windshield Wiper
steps: Lie on back, arms out, legs together.
Lift legs to
degrees.
Rotate legs side to side, keeping shoulders grounded.

results.name: Bodyweight Thoracic Spine Rotation
steps: Start on all fours then bring your chest to the ground. Place one hand on the ground in front of you. The other hand behind your head/ear.
On the side of the hand that is behind your head, rotate until your elbow is pointed at the ceiling and then hold this position.

results.name: Stability Ball Side Crunch
steps: Lie sideways on a stability ball, feet anchored, hands behind head, core engaged.
Crunch sideways by contracting obliques, bringing your upper body toward your hip.

results.name: Bodyweight Step Down
steps: Stand on platform with one foot off edge and torso tall.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee under control.
Drive through standing heel to stand tall again without pushing off bottom foot.

results.name: Bodyweight Partial Step Down
steps: Stand on platform with one foot hanging off edge.
Lower hanging foot toward floor by bending standing knee slightly.
Drive through standing heel to return upright under control.

results.name: Bodyweight Assisted Sissy Squat
steps: Stand tall holding support for balance, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lean back while bending knees, keeping body straight from knees up.
Push through toes and extend knees to return upright.

results.name: Stability Ball Sissy Squat
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, stability ball behind your back against a wall.
Lean back onto the ball, bend knees forward, lowering slowly while keeping hips extended.
Push through toes, straighten legs, and return to standing while maintaining balance and control.

results.name: Wall Sit
steps: Press your back against a wall, feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat position, thighs parallel to the floor, knees above ankles.
Hold the position, maintaining tension in your core and legs.

results.name: Ring Rear Delt Fly
steps: Stand facing rings and grab the handles.
Step forward so that your body is in a plank position, with your arms straight and your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lift your arms out to the side, keeping them at the same height as your shoulders. Your body should form a "T" shape.

results.name: Elevated Pike Shoulder Shrug
steps: Use a bench or an object like a chair to elevate your feet.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

results.name: Bodyweight Pike Shrug
steps: Start in a plank position and raise your hips toward the ceiling.
Slowly lower your body (scapula) while keeping your elbows locked (this is key)
Slowly raise your body back to the start position.

results.name: Diamond Push Ups
steps: Position your index fingers and thumbs so they are touching, forming a diamond shape
Use a standard push up position
Lower your chest towards your hands, keep your elbows close to your body
Stop just before your chest touches the floor, then push back up to the starting position.

results.name: Bench Dips
steps: Grip the edge of the bench with your hands, Keep your feet together and legs straight.
Lower your body straight down.
Slowly press back up to the starting point.
TIP: Make this harder by raising your feet off the floor and adding weight.

results.name: Ring Skullcrusher
steps: Attach the ring straps to a high point. Stand on your tip toes.
Your arms should be extended in front of you.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps. Then extend your elbows back to the start.

results.name: Bodyweight Tricep Extension
steps: Begin in a plank position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.

results.name: Bodyweight Knee Tricep Extension
steps: Begin in kneeling position. Hands shoulder width apart. Break at the elbows while letting your elbows fall to the floor.
Extend your elbows until you are back in the starting position.
